# Which Seating

> Which Seating (whichseating.com) tells readers which seats to pick at major US stadiums and arenas, and which to skip. Facts come from public lists and official pages. Section numbers appear only when a source prints them. Checked 16 Nov 2026.

Independent. Not affiliated with any team, league, or venue.
